content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

Today, you can set up a fully functional payment solution using blockchain technology and free infrastructure tools available online. Begin by creating a digital storefront with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which can host your product listings without cost. Next, integrate NOWPayments for seamless cryptocurrency transactions, allowing you to accept payments in USDT, Bitcoin, or any of the 300+ cryptocurrencies supported. With a few straightforward steps, you can establish a sovereign commerce infrastructure that empowers you to sell your digital products without dependence on traditional payment processors.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

To deploy a minimum viable stack, utilize GitHub Pages for hosting your products and Google Apps Script for backend logic. This combination enables you to manage your sales efficiently and cost-effectively. Integrate NOWPayments to process transactions in USDT on the Tron network, known for its instantaneous settlement times and low fees under $0.10. With this setup, you can launch your digital commerce stack and start receiving payments without delays or complications. This architecture ensures that you maintain control over your sales while eliminating reliance on intermediaries.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focus on essentials and avoid unnecessary complexities in your initial setup. There’s no need to spend time on advanced analytics or marketing automation tools at the beginning. Instead, concentrate on creating a straightforward user experience for your customers with a clean and appealing storefront. Ensure product delivery is efficient by using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for hosting your digital goods. By prioritizing critical functionalities and deferring non-essential enhancements, you can establish a viable payment solution faster and more effectively.
Experience instant payment settlements with USDT on the Tron network for under $0.10.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

Launch your first transaction by first loading your digital products onto your chosen platform. Then, configure your NOWPayments integration to accept cryptocurrency payments. Promote your store through social media channels to attract initial customers. Transactions can be processed instantly, allowing you to experience real-time sales without waiting for bank approvals or payment processing times. Ensure you test the payment flow thoroughly to confirm that everything operates smoothly. Once you receive your first payment, you will validate the effectiveness of your new system.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

Within the next 24 hours, continue refining your storefront and optimizing your payment processes. Reach out to potential customers through your network to generate interest in your products. Explore the possibility of expanding your offerings based on customer feedback and demand. Use the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access all available blueprints and templates that can further enhance the infrastructure you have established. By focusing on immediate actions, you can build momentum for your digital sales and continue to grow your business.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

The most practical path for creators in restricted countries starts with NOWPayments configured to receive USDT on Tron as the primary payment coin. USDT is a stable coin pegged to the US dollar — your revenue does not fluctuate with crypto market movements. Tron network fees are under $0.10, and settlement takes under 60 seconds. Once USDT arrives in your wallet, you convert to local currency through P2P exchanges — Binance P2P is available in most countries and supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. The conversion takes 20 to 30 minutes on average and costs 2 to 5 percent.
Create your digital storefront today without waiting for banking approvals.

Creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and other restricted markets searching for international payment solutions are looking for the same thing: a way to receive USD-equivalent payments from global buyers without a Stripe or PayPal account. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete answer — Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments deployed under your accounts in 48 hours. For creators who want to self-deploy, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 covers both stack options with full source code and step-by-step configuration guides. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Confirm which cryptocurrencies have the best P2P conversion options in your specific country before configuring your payment settings — USDT on Tron is a safe starting point for most African and South Asian markets. Create your NOWPayments account and add wallet addresses for your primary coins. Set up a P2P exchange account — Binance P2P is available in most restricted markets and supports local currency pairs. Deploy your chosen stack: Stack 01 via the Sovereign Blueprint or Stack 02 via the Edge Commerce Stack deployment. Configure the NOWPayments IPN webhook URL in your account settings pointing to your backend endpoint. Run a complete mainnet test transaction and confirm the pipeline end-to-end before promoting. Complete a test P2P conversion with a small amount so you know the process before your first real sale.
